title: Yellow Pages Egypt scraper input
description: Pick a mode. 'category' walks every listing page of a category and captures every card's profile (plus nested branches). 'profile' captures a single profile chain: the parent plus all of its branches, each with its own detail.

mode.description: category = crawl a whole category; profile = capture one profile chain.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. 'gas-stations' (from a /en/category/<slug> URL). Required when mode='category'.

profile_url.description: Full profile URL, e.g. 'https://yellowpages.com.eg/en/profile/emarat-misr/145405'. Required when mode='profile'.

from_category.description: Optional provenance label stored on each record (defaults to the category slug, or '' in profile mode).

crawl_branches.description: Capture each branch's own profile detail and nest it under the parent (and emit it as a flat record). Default true. Accepts a real boolean or the strings 'true'/'false' (the console form submits text).

max_pages.description: Safety cap on category listing pages to crawl. Default 400. Accepts an integer or a numeric string.
